# Accu-Track Financial Solutions

> Accu-Track Financial Solutions is an outsourced contract and licensing operations firm, founded in 1990, that runs contract management, royalty reporting, licensing compliance, and retailer-deduction recovery for US companies. A dedicated team does the work, with no software to implement and no headcount to hire.

## What we do

Accu-Track takes the operational work of contracts and licensing off a company's plate: royalty reporting, reconciliation, and recovery; licensing compliance and obligation tracking; contract administration (renewals, amendments, terminations); retailer deduction and trade-fund recovery (invalid deductions, unearned cash discounts, vendor chargebacks, post-audit claims); post-acquisition contract cleanup; and centralized portfolio visibility. We act as an extension of a client's finance and legal teams, not a replacement, and the client keeps all decision-making authority.

We are an alternative to contract-lifecycle-management (CLM) software and to hiring internal staff. Software still requires people to run it; hiring is slow and expensive. Accu-Track simply does the work.

## Who we work with

US companies whose contracts and licensing agreements have outgrown the people watching them: licensors and licensees across retail, manufacturing, consumer products, and distribution; finance and legal operations teams; consumer-product brands losing margin to retailer deductions; private-equity or corporate-development teams handling post-merger contract integration; and smaller businesses that need a fractional contract team for less than the cost of a full-time hire. Past and current clients include Procter & Gamble, Chemours, Newell Brands, DuPont, and bCreative.

## Proof

On one inherited licensing portfolio, within four months: $27.6M collected, 52% of it directly attributable to Accu-Track's management, including 14% from payers the client did not know existed and 38% that had been paid late or incorrectly.

## How to engage

Start with a free 30-minute assessment. A specialist reviews the current contract landscape and gives an honest read on whether outsourcing makes sense. If there is a fit, a custom scope and proposal follow, and most engagements are operational within 2 to 4 weeks. Response within one business hour.
